profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am currently a student at UCLA who is pursuing a Master's in Computer Science. During this process, I am also a working professional. I expect to graduate in June 2021.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Distributed Autonomy and Responsive Control Team in designing the front-end interface that allows for government customers to monitor, analyze and control the interaction of fleets of unmanned air vehicles under mission scenarios.

Developed code for the GUI interface of a service that provides a key role in enabling advanced mission vignettes and operator interaction during mission exercises.

Designed front-end features on mission operator maps including streamlined display of map data, coordinated tasking control between operators, and integration with other running services.

Assisted in efforts to reduce security vulnerabilities in source code to ensure that it meets customer requirements for later use in government programs.

Led efforts in developing a DevOps Dashboard responsible for displaying status of overnight builds and progress of the software packages that have been scanned for security vulnerabilities.

Wrote a script in LISP that interfaces with schematics in Cadence Virtuoso by traversing through mixed-signal circuits and collecting transistor-level device data.

Updated a post-processing MATLAB script to compute electrical device parameters given physical hardware parameters and validated by comparing results to those generated in Cadence Spectre.

Developed the back-end code and queries for a web application that performed searching and post-processing on RF circuit data from an internal Solr database.

Wrote C code that implements a neural network to model the linear and nonlinear device behaviors for internal company transistors while integrating the device behaviors with Keysight ADS.

Wrote scripts that automated the process of integrating RF module test data, increasing the efficiency for RF module engineers to generate data representations by 30%.

positions.title: RF Microwave Design Engieneer
positions.description:
Wrote a script (in LISP) which integrates with Cadence Virtuoso to traverse through mixed signal circuits and generates a database of individual device biases and physical parameters. I modified a post-processing script (in MATLAB) that uses the information from the database to compute electrical device parameters and creates a CSV database where the data can be analyzed by circuit designers.

I developed back-end code (in Java) for a web interface that uses optimized queries (in SQL) to acquire data from an Oracle database and computes RF circuit parameters. The web interface displays the RF circuit parameters to help designers better determine RF circuits to use in future module designs.

I developed an interface to a device model of a FET that uses a feed-forward neural network algorithm (in C) to model the device's linear, nonlinear, and small-signal characteristics based on measured test data. The interface resulted in a device model that is fully integrated with Keysight ADS where the end user can use the model to run DCIV and S-Parameter simulations.

I created scripts (in Python) that partitions tabular RF module test data to help design engineers better compare module test data to original design specifications.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: I collaborated with a team of 5 software engineers to design a test system that uses a Zync-7000 ZC706 FPGA to automate DCIV tests on circuits used for cubic satellites. I degined a controller (in Python) to monitor communication between a GUI client interface and the FPGA controlling the unit under test. I developed a multithreaded application (in C++) to control the FPGA, allowing for the test system to transmit data through UART between the FPGA and the client machine while simultaneously running verification procedures on the UUT.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Quality Engineering Intern
positions.description: Analyzed and decomposed data from the block diagram of current vehicle infotainment systems into user inputs. Then, from the data, I performed digital logic analysis to identify possible input interactions for test. From my findings, I created a template for a testing process that would exercise the vehicle infotainment system from a user level. From the testing template, I was then able to simulate the test cases into pseudo code which would then be executed by the validation team on test benches using Python.

positions.title: Technical Data Analyst Intern
positions.description: Responsible for creating metrics and reporting responsible for managing activities within the U-Verse Care team. These metric include data for call-volume, call center performance data, and inconsistencies caused by service outages. In the internship, I performed data mining to identify unknown caller IDs received by the company then distributed the data to the appropriate departments to identify suppliers and external competition. I also built rapport with colleagues across the country to gather and process departmental data needed as input to a presentation for the leadership committee of American Express.

projects.title: Embedded Systems Design Laboratory - University of Southern California
projects.description: I developed software and built circuitry for a tracking device that uses the ATMega328p microcontroller to allow for long-range communication without internet connectivity. I wrote code (in C) that allows for the microcontroller to control the behavior of the system's RF transceiver, LCD display, and GPIB controls.

organizations.name: Eta Kappa Nu Electrical and Computer Engineering Honors Society
Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.position: Director of Technical Development · Aug 2013 - May 2017
organizations.description: In this position, I implemented technical workshops that focused on enhancing our member's proficiency using engineering software and hardware tools. I also volunteered in events like Discover Engineering Day, Day at the Museum, and other outreach events that seek to educate elementary, middle, and high school youth about opportunities present in a STEM education.
